description: This file defines the SparkLogger class, a custom logging utility for structured logging within Apache Spark, wrapping SLF4J logger with additional context handling and log level checks.

classes.name: SparkLogger
classes.description: A structured logging utility class for Apache Spark, providing methods for various log levels with support for MDC context and structured logging.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error level logging is enabled.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with a throwable or MDC context.

methods.name: isWarnEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warn level logging is enabled.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message, optionally with a throwable or MDC context.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info level logging is enabled.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with a throwable or MDC context.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug level logging is enabled.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message with various overloads for formatting and arguments.

methods.name: isTraceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if trace level logging is enabled.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a trace message with various overloads for formatting and arguments.

methods.name: withLogContext
methods.description: Internal method to add MDC context to logs and execute logging within that context.
